title: Session: 2.37.1 Caddy worktree acceptance

Accept backend/proxy readiness, sole writer lease, scoped command inventory and backup/restore evidence. Check officer login and ordinary-member denial.
Use a bot-only rehearsal to check compatibility. Approve production only after its own healthy baseline and acceptance prerequisites are ready.
assistant: Reproduce Caddy denial with a 0600 template in a umask-077 Git worktree, then run the corrected entry against real Caddy without read-override capabilities; check release/startup metadata and host transitions.
Diagnose owner-reported results, preserve scope and record exercised verification separately from unverified live acceptance.
Perform no live host, token, database, Discord, environment or deployment operations. This plan grants no live-operation authorization.
bot: Run one DevBot instance under the staging profile, with effects initially paused and strict managed-database/test-guild guards.
Serve dashboard pages from the same bot process only when web is enabled; require Discord sign-in and officer authority, and keep server reads scoped.
Keep acquisition and reconciliation in the declared test guild; dashboard pages change no settings and trigger no Discord retries or decisions.
Expose database, Discord and writer-lease readiness; report 2.37.1, startup time and effect state without pinging members.
